governance_rule.title: Patch and Schema Preservation Rule
governance_rule.rule: All patches, schemas, manifests, config templates, migration files, registry updates, and construction JSON used in project development must be saved as durable project artifacts.

requirements.patch_archival: Every applied or proposed patch must be saved before or during execution.
requirements.schema_archival: Every schema used to validate, construct, migrate, or govern the project must be saved.
requirements.auto_create_json: If no appropriate JSON artifact exists for a patch, schema, or construction step, the agent must create one.

governance_rule.agent_instruction: Before applying project changes, check whether a durable patch/schema JSON exists. If not, create one. After applying changes, update its status, affected files, validation result, and rollback notes.
